appDescription: A Korean audio adventure app for one or two registered child players. Parent setup and vehicle policy checks are required before play.

function.name: START_PLAY
function.description: Open the play-start flow for registered players after checking parental configuration and current vehicle permissions.

function.name: RESUME_PLAY
function.description: Explicitly resume the saved adventure after rechecking current platform and audio conditions.

function.name: PAUSE_PLAY
function.description: Stop this app's audio immediately, preserve the quiet intent and pause the current adventure without an additional spoken confirmation.
